name: Cube Fiesta Surat 2018

venue.name: SDJ International College
venue.address: SDJ International College, Near Indian Diamond Institute, City Center, Someshwara Enclave, Vesu, Surat, Gujarat -395010

information: There is NO age limit for participating in the event. Participants have to bring their own cubes. Registration is on 1st come 1st serve basis. Only the 1st 100 participants will be accepted for this competition. For more details on the registration process please check the [registrations & payments](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeFiestaSuratIII2018#5851-registration-payment) tab. For the tentative competition schedule please check the [schedule and Round Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeFiestaSuratIII2018#5881-schedule-and-round-details) tab
